metadata.title: Payments and Revenue Infrastructure Product Streams
metadata.description: Customer and operator flows with explicit decisions, recovery and financial evidence. The flows are a logical model, not a claim that all optional products are available together in every region.
metadata.flowModelNote: Steps identify the responsible capabilities and external contracts. Optional, preview and entity-specific functions retain their eligibility restrictions.

streams.name: Accept Payments Globally with High Conversion
streams.description: Move an eligible purchase from checkout intent to captured funds and reconciled exceptions. Merchant, processor and merchant-of-record responsibilities remain explicit.
outcomes: Controlled fraud loss and payment cost

flows.title: Accept Payments Globally with High Conversion
flows.description: Move an eligible purchase from checkout intent to captured funds and reconciled exceptions. Merchant, processor and merchant-of-record responsibilities remain explicit.

steps.title: Launch the right checkout surface
keyFacts: Bind the merchant order, offer and consent to a checkout session.
painPoints: An abandoned or repeated session must not create duplicate collection.

dependencies.name: Payment Links
dependencies.description: Resolve a payment-link offer to a session.
dependencies.how: Resolve a payment-link offer to a session.

steps.title: Present eligible methods and routing choices
keyFacts: Method eligibility is separate from optional processor routing; restricted integrations retain their product limits.
painPoints: A supported recipient market or method does not imply universal merchant eligibility.

dependencies.name: Processor Routing and Execution Contracts
dependencies.description: Apply eligible processor route rules when enabled.
dependencies.how: Apply eligible processor route rules when enabled.

steps.title: Authenticate, authorize and capture
keyFacts: Track each attempt and final capture independently from the browser result.
painPoints: Timeouts and issuer declines require state recovery before retry.

dependencies.name: Authorization Optimization
dependencies.description: Preserve attempts, authentication and capture state.
dependencies.how: Preserve attempts, authentication and capture state.

dependencies.name: Fraud Detection and Adaptive Risk Controls
dependencies.description: Apply risk policy and review controls.
dependencies.how: Apply risk policy and review controls.

steps.title: Protect and operate the transaction
keyFacts: Signed asynchronous events update order and financial state with deduplication.
painPoints: Duplicate or unordered delivery can cause incorrect fulfillment or accounting.

dependencies.name: Developer API and Dashboard Foundations
dependencies.description: Control integration access and request identity.
dependencies.how: Control integration access and request identity.

steps.title: Resolve refunds and disputes
keyFacts: Link reversals and evidence to the original transaction and responsible provider.
painPoints: A refund request can remain pending; third-party processor cases require their own handling.

steps.title: Reconcile received funds
keyFacts: Match gross, net, fees and currency to settlement evidence.
painPoints: A captured payment is not yet an explained cash receipt.

streams.name: Operate Unified Commerce and Store Recovery
streams.description: Keep stores, digital checkout, cross-channel returns and settlement connected through order and payment references.

flows.title: Operate Unified Commerce and Store Recovery
flows.description: Keep stores, digital checkout, cross-channel returns and settlement connected through order and payment references.

steps.title: Prepare the store and reader
keyFacts: Store operators confirm reader readiness and eligible methods before trading.
painPoints: A configured reader can still be unavailable or outside regional/product coverage.

steps.title: Link order and payment across channels
keyFacts: Merchant order identity must survive the transition between online and physical touchpoints.
painPoints: Payment data alone does not supply inventory or fulfillment truth.

steps.title: Recover delayed offline collection
keyFacts: Retain the original local transaction and later collection result.
painPoints: Offline acceptance can leave the merchant exposed if later collection fails.

dependencies.name: Terminal and Reader Operations
dependencies.description: Queue and recover eligible offline transactions.
dependencies.how: Queue and recover eligible offline transactions.

steps.title: Return across channels
keyFacts: Use the original order/payment reference and disclosed refund policy.
painPoints: Store and online systems can otherwise issue conflicting refunds.

steps.title: Close store activity and settlement
keyFacts: Reconcile store totals and original transactions to provider settlement.
painPoints: A matched device total does not explain fees, FX or settlement timing.

streams.name: Serve Authorized Agent Commerce
streams.description: Expose accurate merchant offers and checkout state to an eligible agent channel, then execute a bounded purchase with attributable payment evidence.

flows.title: Serve Authorized Agent Commerce
flows.description: Expose accurate merchant offers and checkout state to an eligible agent channel, then execute a bounded purchase with attributable payment evidence.

steps.title: Publish current purchasable offers
keyFacts: Feed accurate product, price and availability data from the merchant system.
painPoints: A stale catalog can create an order the merchant cannot fulfill.

steps.title: Confirm cart facts and responsibility
keyFacts: Refresh price, tax, delivery and seller identity at purchase time.
painPoints: A recommendation is not a final executable order.

dependencies.name: Hosted Checkout
dependencies.description: Bind current cart to the order/session.
dependencies.how: Bind current cart to the order/session.

dependencies.name: Tax Determination and Registration
dependencies.description: Apply the responsible party’s tax treatment.
dependencies.how: Apply the responsible party’s tax treatment.

steps.title: Verify authority and execute payment
keyFacts: Bind the actual principal and delegated action to the purchase where the integration supports it.
painPoints: An authenticated agent credential is not unlimited spending permission.

dependencies.name: Fraud Detection and Adaptive Risk Controls
Authorization Optimization
dependencies.description: Execute the payment with an attributable result.
dependencies.how: Execute the payment with an attributable result.

steps.title: Confirm and recover order state
keyFacts: Use payment events and authoritative state to confirm fulfillment and recovery.
painPoints: An agent retry after an ambiguous response can duplicate a purchase.

dependencies.name: Disputes and Chargeback Operations
dependencies.description: Route post-purchase issues to their owner.
dependencies.how: Route post-purchase issues to their owner.

streams.name: Automate Recurring Revenue and Finance Workflows
streams.description: Release pricing and collect recurring or usage charges with reproducible rating, explicit correction and a controlled finance handoff.

flows.title: Automate Recurring Revenue and Finance Workflows
flows.description: Release pricing and collect recurring or usage charges with reproducible rating, explicit correction and a controlled finance handoff.

steps.title: Define and version commercial terms
keyFacts: Select Billing/Metronome compatibility and approve rates, commitments and tax responsibility.
painPoints: An unversioned pricing change makes past charges impossible to explain.

dependencies.name: Subscription and Price Management
dependencies.description: Own accepted subscription and price versions.
dependencies.how: Own accepted subscription and price versions.

steps.title: Meter, rate and consume credits
keyFacts: Deduplicate usage, preserve event time and apply the accepted rate; credits are consumption entitlements.
painPoints: Late events, duplicate events and credit exhaustion can change the invoice.

dependencies.name: Usage Metering and Rating
dependencies.description: Normalize events, rate usage and apply corrections.
dependencies.how: Normalize events, rate usage and apply corrections.

steps.title: Validate and issue the invoice
keyFacts: Reconcile lines, credit consumption and tax before collection.
painPoints: A billing run can be numerically valid while using the wrong contract.

dependencies.name: Invoicing and Collections
dependencies.description: Issue controlled invoice and credit-note records.
dependencies.how: Issue controlled invoice and credit-note records.

steps.title: Collect and recover failed payments
keyFacts: Use current invoice state to coordinate payment and dunning.
painPoints: Repeated retries can duplicate collection or hide involuntary churn.

steps.title: Correct and recognize revenue
keyFacts: Link adjustments to usage and commercial terms before applying recognition rules.
painPoints: Cash collection and revenue recognition differ in timing and purpose.

steps.title: Export and close
keyFacts: Finance accepts the export after source records and settlement reconcile.
painPoints: Disconnected exports leave unexplained balances at month end.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: The merchant supplies correct customer, event, unit and correction semantics.
The controller accepts accounting treatment and reconciliation.

streams.name: Sell Eligible Digital Products with Managed Payments
streams.description: Choose and operate an eligible merchant-of-record arrangement with clear checkout, tax, transaction-support and finance handoffs.
outcomes: Correct buyer charges and support ownership

flows.title: Sell Eligible Digital Products with Managed Payments
flows.description: Choose and operate an eligible merchant-of-record arrangement with clear checkout, tax, transaction-support and finance handoffs.

steps.title: Confirm seller and product scope
keyFacts: Record the eligible digital product, selling entity and supported integration.
painPoints: The arrangement does not support every product, country or Connect use case.

steps.title: Publish an eligible purchase offer
keyFacts: Connect the agreed price and responsibility to the supported hosted checkout path.
painPoints: An unsupported embedded or platform integration cannot inherit the same promise.

dependencies.name: Subscription and Price Management
dependencies.description: Supply accepted subscription terms where supported.
dependencies.how: Supply accepted subscription terms where supported.

steps.title: Collect and handle the applicable tax
keyFacts: The selected arrangement determines who performs transaction and indirect-tax work.
painPoints: Tax calculation alone does not establish registration, filing or seller-of-record responsibility.

dependencies.name: Tax Determination and Registration
dependencies.description: Record applicable tax treatment and owner.
dependencies.how: Record applicable tax treatment and owner.

steps.title: Handle buyer cases with an identified owner
keyFacts: Transaction support and dispute/refund escalation follow the agreement.
painPoints: Buyers and sellers can otherwise be passed between support teams.

steps.title: Reconcile seller proceeds
keyFacts: Separate charges, tax, fees, refunds and net proceeds.
painPoints: A net amount without lineage is insufficient for the seller’s accounting.

streams.name: Operate Platform Money Movement Safely
streams.description: Activate an eligible counterparty, allocate funds under the contracted liability model and complete a traceable recipient payout.

flows.title: Operate Platform Money Movement Safely
flows.description: Activate an eligible counterparty, allocate funds under the contracted liability model and complete a traceable recipient payout.

steps.title: Identify the legal party and role
keyFacts: Separate legal identity, service role, funds owner and loss bearer.
painPoints: One generic account label hides important responsibility differences.

dependencies.name: Connected Account Lifecycle
dependencies.description: Record roles and product capability requirements.
dependencies.how: Record roles and product capability requirements.

steps.title: Verify and remediate capabilities
keyFacts: Activation and later restrictions depend on required evidence and review.
painPoints: Repeated unexplained evidence requests cause recipient abandonment.

steps.title: Collect and allocate the payment
keyFacts: A successful payment is split only under the effective party and fee/reserve rules.
painPoints: An apparently successful split can assign loss or funds to the wrong party.

steps.title: Fund and instruct a verified payout
keyFacts: Check available funds, recipient destination, restrictions and the promised window.
painPoints: A payout API response does not establish that the recipient can use the money.

dependencies.name: Payout Execution and Returns
dependencies.description: Validate destination and create a funded instruction.
dependencies.how: Validate destination and create a funded instruction.

steps.title: Resolve returns and negative balances
keyFacts: Preserve the original instruction and contracted recourse; explain actions to the recipient.
painPoints: Blindly reissuing a delayed payout can duplicate payment.

dependencies.name: Payout Execution and Returns
dependencies.description: Track failures, returns and controlled reissue.
dependencies.how: Track failures, returns and controlled reissue.

steps.title: Reconcile the recipient statement
keyFacts: Show gross earnings, fees, reserves, returns and net received amount.
painPoints: An unexplained statement damages recipient trust even when payment succeeded.

dependencies.name: Reconciliation and Balance Operations
dependencies.description: Match internal and external financial records.
dependencies.how: Match internal and external financial records.

streams.description: Let a platform participant assess and use an eligible account, card or financing offer with explicit obligations and support.

steps.title: Assess eligibility for the selected product
keyFacts: Account, issuing and capital eligibility are different decisions.
painPoints: Payment acceptance eligibility can be mistaken for financial-product approval.

dependencies.name: Connected Account Lifecycle
dependencies.description: Read product and jurisdiction capability policy.
dependencies.how: Read product and jurisdiction capability policy.

steps.title: Disclose and accept terms
keyFacts: Identify funds ownership, fees, spending controls or repayment obligations before acceptance.
painPoints: Bundled product language can conceal liability or an unwanted financing obligation.

steps.title: Execute under product controls
keyFacts: Spend, transfers and repayment use the effective agreement and available funds.
painPoints: Limits and eligibility can change after onboarding.

steps.title: Reconcile and support the participant
keyFacts: Provide statements, clear support ownership and a path to resolve restrictions.
painPoints: Unexplained deductions or holds undermine product trust.

flows.title: Run Trust and Finance Operations
flows.description: Resolve financial and risk exceptions, reconcile obligations to external cash and approve the reporting close.

steps.title: Control access and ingest evidence
keyFacts: Authenticate operators and persist attributable source events before processing.
painPoints: Leaked credentials or duplicate processing can corrupt money records.

steps.title: Review risk and disputes
keyFacts: Link risk actions and dispute decisions to the original financial exposure.
painPoints: A case closure is incomplete until monetary adjustments are explained.

dependencies.name: Fraud Detection and Adaptive Risk Controls

steps.title: Match obligations to settlement
keyFacts: Compare transaction, transfer, fee, FX and return references with statements.
painPoints: Matching only totals can conceal offsetting errors.

steps.title: Resolve material differences
keyFacts: A named owner investigates aged items and approves corrections.
painPoints: Unowned differences accumulate into an unreliable close.

dependencies.description: Adjust recognition schedules under approved policy.
dependencies.how: Adjust recognition schedules under approved policy.

steps.title: Approve and publish the close
keyFacts: Separate cash reconciliation from revenue treatment and retain approval lineage.
painPoints: Uncontrolled exports can diverge from accepted financial state.

dependencies.how: Preserve approved access and action evidence.

streams.description: Fund obligations and make recipient cash available through the business’s eligible financial-account and payout arrangements.

flows.title: Manage Business Liquidity and Standalone Payouts
flows.description: Fund obligations and make recipient cash available through the business’s eligible financial-account and payout arrangements.

steps.title: Confirm the account arrangement
keyFacts: Identify legal holder, service/bank relationship, entity eligibility and the party authorized to move funds.
painPoints: Broad recipient reach does not prove the sender can use the product.

dependencies.name: Financial Accounts and Business Liquidity
dependencies.description: Record account structure and funding terms.
dependencies.how: Record account structure and funding terms.

steps.title: Fund and convert for the obligation
keyFacts: Use available money and an approved FX quote/fee when needed.
painPoints: A pending balance or expired FX quote cannot fund an unconditional promise.

dependencies.name: Balances and Internal Ledger
dependencies.description: Distinguish pending, reserved and available funds.
dependencies.how: Distinguish pending, reserved and available funds.

steps.title: Approve and send the payout
keyFacts: Validate the destination and obtain the required approval before execution.
painPoints: A changed beneficiary or broad mandate can misdirect money.

dependencies.name: Delegated Authority and Approvals
dependencies.description: Record bounded approval where automation is used.
dependencies.how: Record bounded approval where automation is used.

steps.title: Track recipient access and resolve returns
keyFacts: Preserve the instruction/provider references until funds are available or returned.
painPoints: Timeouts must not trigger a blind duplicate payout.

steps.title: Reconcile cash by entity and currency
keyFacts: Match external statements and return/FX records to the funding obligation.
painPoints: A single consolidated total conceals entity and currency differences.

streams.name: Execute Spending within Delegated Authority
streams.description: Allow an eligible automated financial action only within an approved business mandate, and preserve human control over ambiguity or exceptions.

flows.title: Execute Spending within Delegated Authority
flows.description: Allow an eligible automated financial action only within an approved business mandate, and preserve human control over ambiguity or exceptions.

steps.title: Define the mandate
keyFacts: A named principal approves actor, purpose, recipient scope, budget, expiry and allowed product.
painPoints: Broad access credentials do not establish the business purpose or budget.

steps.title: Check at execution time
keyFacts: Recheck revocation, remaining authority and available funding before execution.
painPoints: Authority can expire or funds can change after a plan is made.

steps.title: Execute once and observe state
keyFacts: Preserve request identity and wait for the authoritative financial result.
painPoints: An ambiguous timeout does not justify repeating a payment.

steps.title: Escalate, revoke and reconcile
keyFacts: A human resolves exceptions; revocation blocks future actions and accounting retains completed action evidence.
painPoints: Revocation cannot be assumed to reverse an already completed financial action.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Only supported product actions are eligible; roadmap card features are not assumed available.
